name: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited
summary: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited engages in buying, distributing, and retailing pre-owned motor vehicles in South Africa. It is involved in the sales of car finance, insurance, and other ancillary products, such as tracking devices, value added insurance products, and comprehensive motor insurance. The company also engages in the operation of car supermarket; and owns and rents warehouses. It sells its products through physical supermarkets and its digital platforms. The company was formerly known as WBC Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to We Buy Cars Holdings Limited in March 2024. We Buy Cars Holdings Limited is based in Centurion, South Africa.
